title: Jump Itô-type formula with arbitrary regularity
summary: We establish an Itô-type formula for finite $p$-variation paths with jumps for arbitrary $p\geq 1$. The formula is stated in a fully pathwise form and separates the reduced rough integral from explicit left- and right-jump correction terms. In the càdlàg case, only the left-jump correction remains, while in the continuous case, both jump correction terms vanish and the formula recovers the corresponding continuous arbitrary-regularity change-of-variable formula.
